data.text: I’m in for 10 tons. That’s $10,000 each this month without eating into next month’s livelihood—something worth protecting for our families and the village. Luke, there’s room to arrange a bigger catch if someone freely offers part of their share, provided we confirm it together and stay within 50 total. Let’s check everyone’s catch afterward and agree on next month’s limits based on what’s in the lake. John, are you on board?
